subject.title: experimental.sessionMemory does not surface gateway-dispatched sessions in memory_search

question: Should OpenClaw accept owner-scoped live orphan session transcript hits in `memory_search` when session visibility permits, while keeping broader private cross-conversation recall behind a separate default-off owner/admin setting?
rationale: The remaining behavior is both a real session recall gap and a private transcript visibility boundary, and current open PRs propose different scopes that need maintainer alignment before implementation cleanup.

options.title: Land Targeted Fix First
options.body: Accept a narrow visibility-preserving fix such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92261, then keep broader private recall as a separate product setting.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Recall
options.body: Pause the narrow runtime fix and resolve the behavior only through the default-off remember-across-conversations feature path.

options.title: Keep Fail-Closed
options.body: Continue denying store-missing live transcript hits unless a canonical session-store entry exists, preserving the strictest boundary but leaving this gateway recall gap unresolved.

recommendation.title: Land Targeted Fix First
recommendation.body: Accept a narrow visibility-preserving fix such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92261, then keep broader private recall as a separate product setting.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the active maintainer-labeled private recall product direction that must align with any targeted session-memory visibility fix.
